rationale: Zero-ask approver regression check on c15860ab in the decomposition lens: clean. The diff is confined to the OQ-1 protocol paragraph and bead 6 (steps 1/5 + the fixture roster); beads 1-5 and 7-10 untouched; no depends_on changed in any of the seven commits; no new file names introduced (trailer builders + reader ride the existing CommitMessageBody primitive in gitutil, CAS publish helpers are plain update-ref in gitutil, fixtures in complete_test.go, the amendment in ADR-0041 + its test) — chunk/section parity holds in its final state. One decomposition-POSITIVE change deserves the record: the round-6 G2 instrument choice (per-ref CAS, deliberately NOT bead 1's phase lock, rationale recorded in-plan) prevents what would have been a genuine new inter-bead coupling — had the marker publication taken the phase lock, beads 1 and 6 would have acquired a lock-ordering relationship and a shared-instrument seam beyond their declared same-file edge; the CAS choice keeps their only relationship the 6→[1] edge already in the frontmatter. On the lead's question — seventeen legs and the final reviewability judgment: STANDS, keep whole. The three growth rounds added legs in strict proportion to mechanism decisions (two one-ref windows for write-ahead, one race leg for CAS, three elision-classification legs for the trailer, one split for the single-S-resume route), never as free-floating scope; the count label is consistent under the plan's own convention (seventeen roman-numeral legs, viii being one leg with two pinned runs); and the mechanism a bead-6 panel must hold in mind remains one write-ahead state machine whose every element now has a named falsifier. Nothing in this diff is implementation-corrupting; the plan's decomposition is in its best state of the seven rounds.

findings.title: Bead 6 final reviewability judgment: stands — acceptable-but-large, keep whole, seventeen legs are proportionate
findings.detail: Each growth round's legs map one-to-one onto mechanism decisions the panel forced: (xii)/(xiii) pin the write-ahead design's two one-ref-installed crash windows; (xiv) pins the CAS publication race; (xv)-(xvii) pin the trailer discriminator's three elision classes; (viii-a)/(viii-b) split one leg into its refuse and converge halves for the single authoritative S-resume route. The fixture matrix is the falsification instrument that makes a single-bead review of this machine tractable — it is not accumulated scope. The production mechanism surface has been simplified twice across the same rounds (LockFileEx replacing the takeover dance; write-ahead replacing the two-ref transaction) while the matrix grew, which is the correct direction on both axes. The keep-whole rationale from rounds 2-6 is unchanged and now carries seven rounds of evidence: every substantive defect this gate found lived in the primitive-vs-consumer seam a split would sever.

findings.title: G2's instrument choice is decomposition-positive: no new bead-1/bead-6 coupling
findings.detail: Marker publication uses per-ref CAS (update-ref CREATE / expected-old) rather than bead 1's phase lock, with the rationale recorded in-plan: no lock-ordering edge between the phase-metadata and materialization subsystems. Had the phase lock been chosen, bead 6 would have gained a real dependency on bead 1's lock semantics (and every future reviewer a two-subsystem lock-ordering proof obligation); as designed, the beads' only relationship remains the declared 6→[1] same-file edge on complete.go. The seam discipline the panel has enforced on this plan since round 1 is here being applied by the fix author unprompted.
